name: Rubber-Hose Geometry
visual_idea: Hand-inked elastic characters, dancing geometric exhibits and painted theatrical backdrops; every machine has an animated personality.
tradeoff: Excellent movement character; the nostalgic comedy could overpower the mystery.

name: Festival Brush
visual_idea: Broad painted shapes, lush color layering and enormous readable gestures; the museum behaves like a living carnival of mathematics.
tradeoff: Needs restraint so decorative detail does not obscure the route.

name: Lantern & Shadow
reference: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
visual_idea: Luminous painted museum rooms, amber pools of safety and cool impossible spaces; fluid leaps cross deep diagonal compositions.
tradeoff: Beautiful light needs a clear silhouette and collision layer underneath it.

name: Velvet Silhouette
visual_idea: Ink-dark figures against softly etched architecture, lantern halos and precise clean silhouettes; a mysterious miniature university.
tradeoff: Too much darkness or too small a hero would undermine the requested cinematic presence.

name: Watercolor Clockwork
visual_idea: Loose watercolor washes and sharply inked mechanical props; color visibly bleeds when the geometry fails.
tradeoff: A delicate image can feel passive unless the animation is unusually forceful.

name: Dissolving Gouache
visual_idea: Large matte painted color fields, sculptural figures and architecture that changes pigment with the story.
tradeoff: Atmospheric, but abstract restraint is less suited to a first action-heavy release.

name: Lantern Storybook
visual_idea: Warm hand-drawn faces, beautiful ordinary objects and softly lit interiors make the catastrophe emotionally personal.
tradeoff: Warmth needs a stronger danger language for arcade encounters.

name: Cut-Paper Fiesta
visual_idea: Angular flat-color silhouettes, exuberant transformation effects and bold geometric world boundaries.
tradeoff: The original reference's cultural identity must not become a generic decorative costume.

name: Living Ink Adventure
visual_idea: Supple hand-drawn characters with thick clean outlines against painted scenery; movement feels animated by hand.
tradeoff: The familiar side-view platform language must be replaced with room-scale oblique compositions.

name: Cel-Animated Serial
visual_idea: A full animated-adventure serial: expressive acting, dramatic cuts and enormous theatrical obstacles.
tradeoff: Cinematic appearance must not reduce play to memorized quick-time events.

name: Inkstorm
visual_idea: Confident contour lines, hard shadow shapes, vermilion impacts and diagonal staging; the whole museum becomes a kinetic graphic novel.
tradeoff: Dense ornament must be separated from interactable silhouettes.

name: Copper Dream City
visual_idea: Lacquered jade, copper and cream surfaces, elegant silhouettes and decorative geometry that carries the world's identity.
tradeoff: Its restrained pace needs substantial animation and movement energy for this audience.

name: Painted Fragments
visual_idea: Hand-painted platforms assemble out of darkness; a museum chamber physically builds itself as the explorer approaches.
tradeoff: Constant assembly effects could make route planning difficult.

name: Pop-Beat Academy
visual_idea: Graphic cel shading, elastic animated poses and rhythmic environmental motion; machinery seems to dance before it breaks.
tradeoff: A rhythm requirement must remain optional and must never time mathematical thinking.

name: Street-Line Geometry
visual_idea: Chunky outlined 3D shapes, graffiti-like geometry and broad color blocking; rails and ramps become expressive traversal.
tradeoff: A street-culture emphasis would need a convincing university-specific identity.

name: Future Campus Graffiti
visual_idea: Bright urban cel shading and skating-like momentum through a campus transformed into an angular playground.
tradeoff: Strong for an interlude; weaker for the intimate first museum mystery.

name: Panel-Breaker
visual_idea: Panel borders become physical architecture and action bursts through drawn frames; cutscenes use moving comic compositions.
tradeoff: Panel conventions should not become another grid-like screen layout.

name: Impact Theater
visual_idea: Huge foreground characters, elastic perspective, dramatic zooms and striking pauses at the instant of impact.
tradeoff: Camera effects need strict limits so combat remains readable.

name: Monochrome Voltage
visual_idea: An abstract black-and-white ink world with one electric accent; stark silhouettes give every hit visual weight.
tradeoff: Borrow only graphic contrast, not the reference's violence; insufficient warmth as the main direction.

name: Urban Collage Pulse
visual_idea: Fashion-forward silhouettes, editorial collage and typography-inspired shapes create an assertive graphic identity.
tradeoff: Too much graphic information would compete with readable mathematics.

name: The Midnight Museum
visual_idea: Tactile stylized 3D, expressive frightened-but-brave acting, playful machinery and dramatic rooms; an animated feature under player control.
tradeoff: Requires substantial character rigging, facial animation and environment production.

name: Rocket-Powered Wonder
visual_idea: Bold sculpted silhouettes, dazzling mechanical transformations and close cinematic tracking shots through impossible space.
tradeoff: Large effects and detailed 3D scenes require a disciplined browser performance budget.

name: Crooked Minds
visual_idea: Distinctive caricatured characters and emotionally expressive architecture; rooms warp according to the mystery rather than physics.
tradeoff: Exaggeration must remain consistent instead of becoming arbitrary visual noise.

name: Oversized Everyday
visual_idea: Ordinary museum objects become spectacular terrain through scale changes, playful materials and expressive character interactions.
tradeoff: Scale gimmicks need a stable sense of the protagonist's size.

name: Gentle Spirits, Sharp Action
visual_idea: Warm sculpted characters, tiny creature companions and luminous environmental magic in a cinematic 3D world.
tradeoff: Avoid allowing the reference's forest vocabulary to replace the mathematics museum.

name: Pocket Adventurer
visual_idea: Bouncy proportions, readable toy-like architecture and a charming oversized protagonist in colorful rooms.
tradeoff: Could skew younger or lighter than the intended espionage-adventure atmosphere.

name: Sculpted Playground
visual_idea: Every object advertises its physical affordance; clean rounded forms make movement and experimentation inviting.
tradeoff: Needs a distinctive mystery palette to avoid feeling like a general platforming theme park.

name: Precision Toy Cinema
visual_idea: Small crafted sets, delightful reactive details, crisp expressive animation and immediately understandable interactions.
tradeoff: Toy appeal is strong, but the hero should feel like a person rather than a mascot machine.

name: Elastic Hazard Museum
visual_idea: Exaggerated squash-and-stretch, strong depth cues and spectacular moving obstacles with unmistakable timing.
tradeoff: Strict reaction timing should never bleed into the math interface.

name: Gemstone Adventure
visual_idea: Rich jewel colors, stylized stonework, broad silhouettes and inviting light; rooms feel like collectible animated sets.
tradeoff: A very soft fantasy palette may weaken the unsettling scientific mystery.

name: Paper Paradox
visual_idea: A premium papercraft world whose rooms fold, tear and unfold; geometry is literally made of manipulated material.
tradeoff: Enemy combat and facial acting need a strong stop-motion language to avoid a craft-demo feeling.

name: Folded Kingdom
visual_idea: Flat expressive figures encounter three-dimensional folded mechanisms; door solutions crease new routes into existence.
tradeoff: Too close a character silhouette could feel derivative; original proportions are essential.

name: Cardboard Observatory
visual_idea: Museum exhibits built from recycled card, tape and painted props; revealing the reverse of a set becomes a discovery.
tradeoff: The handcrafted charm can read as preschool unless the design is more sophisticated.

name: Threaded Equations
visual_idea: Threads, seams and fabric tension become visible traversal rules; unraveling an exhibit reveals another route.
tradeoff: Textile physics would be expensive to animate consistently across many mechanics.

name: Workshop Miniatures
visual_idea: A theatrical world of fabric, wood, springs and handmade machinery with physical-looking puzzle connections.
tradeoff: Shared materials alone do not create a sufficiently original narrative identity.

name: Clay Laboratory
visual_idea: Hand-sculpted clay figures, visibly worked surfaces and eccentric stop-motion mechanisms inside an uncanny research building.
tradeoff: Clay animation needs excellent acting or the scene becomes visually heavy.

name: Model-Set Science Fiction
visual_idea: Photographed miniature-like environments with tactile industrial surfaces and carefully staged light.
tradeoff: Its subdued tone is better for a restricted lab than the whole opening Tower.

name: Macro-Scale Mystery
visual_idea: Extreme material close-ups and tiny-scale environmental traversal turn ordinary objects into cinematic landscapes.
tradeoff: A continuously tiny protagonist would conflict with the requested strong character presence.

name: Crayon Conspiracy
visual_idea: Energetic rough drawing, handmade marks and childlike imagination turn a serious mystery into a vivid adventure.
tradeoff: The roughness must be intentional and consistent to avoid looking unfinished.

name: Stop-Motion University
visual_idea: Handmade puppets, painted miniature rooms and patient cinematic staging create a completely tangible fictional university.
tradeoff: A superb film language, but its usual measured pace needs reworking for arcade action.

name: Liquid Pixel Combat
visual_idea: Crisp pixel silhouettes, exceptionally fluid poses and dense reactive effects; every action has a readable anticipation and follow-through.
tradeoff: A horizontal corridor format is unsuitable; borrow animation language only.

name: Neon Frame Noir
visual_idea: Bold neon reflections, cinematic pixel close-ups and rapid controlled cuts make a compact scene feel like a film.
tradeoff: The adult noir tone and violence should not carry into this children's adventure.

name: Prismatic Ruins
visual_idea: Saturated color clusters, silent monumental shapes and precise top-down silhouettes; mathematical ruins glow against deep shadow.
tradeoff: The story cannot depend on ambiguity alone because the user wants a fully presented film narrative.

name: Prism Runner
visual_idea: Large readable isometric pixel action, luminous prisms and kinetic diagonal traversal through a single elaborate room.
tradeoff: Pixel nostalgia may not deliver the cinematic transformation the user wants most.

name: Luminous Pixel Diorama
visual_idea: Dense crafted pixel environments with cinematic lighting, depth and expressive animation at a room scale.
tradeoff: A full film-like face performance is harder at the gameplay sprite resolution.

name: Warm Pixel Metropolis
visual_idea: Richly observed everyday interiors, warm imperfect lighting and characterful pixel acting ground an extraordinary event.
tradeoff: Environmental density needs simplification for fast combat and mathematical attention.

name: Mechanical Color Story
visual_idea: Bright machine silhouettes, expressive animation and clear mechanical causes and effects make a research complex playful.
tradeoff: The source's flat platform composition must not carry over as repeated floor strips.

name: Skyborne Pixel Opera
visual_idea: Detailed airborne silhouettes and painterly pixel skies support dramatic climbs, leaps and exterior Tower shots.
tradeoff: Excellent for exterior moments; less distinctive for many enclosed museum rooms.

name: Clean Pixel Emotion
visual_idea: A restrained pixel vocabulary gives movement clarity while expressive portraits and sound carry emotional beats.
tradeoff: Separate portrait dialogue is weaker than the fully staged movie presentation requested here.

name: Engraved Pixel Palace
visual_idea: Highly detailed etched stone, solemn silhouettes and elaborate architectural pixel work suggest an uncanny mathematical institution.
tradeoff: Use architectural craft only; the reference's graphic and religious horror is a poor core fit for this child.

name: Nested Object Worlds
visual_idea: Smooth sculptural geometry and worlds contained inside portable objects make the mathematical premise physically legible.
tradeoff: Its minimal exposition needs much fuller character acting and dialogue.

name: Miniature Secret Academy
visual_idea: An intimate isometric world with charming proportions, deep environmental clues and secret routes hidden in plain sight.
tradeoff: A distant tabletop camera needs cinematic close-ups to retain emotional connection.

name: Quiet Geometric Mystery
visual_idea: Readable diorama architecture, carefully limited palettes and graphic silhouettes create elegance without clutter.
tradeoff: Its restrained mood needs more warmth and spectacle for the opening setpiece.

name: Impossible Monument
visual_idea: Architecture changes through elegant spatial transformations and striking graphic composition; each room is a visual puzzle.
tradeoff: The serene puzzle pace does not itself provide the requested arcade energy.

name: Rotating Perspective
visual_idea: A simple-looking room reveals new relationships when the camera rotates; the building's geometry becomes the main surprise.
tradeoff: Free rotation can conflict with precise combat and requires clear orientation rules.

name: Shadow Stage
visual_idea: Sparse controlled staging, exceptional character motion and ominous environmental storytelling without visual clutter.
tradeoff: The oppressive tone and muted palette are too severe as the default for this audience.

name: Uncanny Dollhouse
visual_idea: Objects dwarf the protagonist, low cameras build suspense, and rooms feel like elaborate cinematic sets.
tradeoff: Its child-in-peril horror is stronger than this game needs; borrow scale and staging selectively.

name: Clean Test-Chamber Surrealism
visual_idea: Precise industrial forms make impossible spatial connections easy to understand; visual comedy emerges from machinery.
tradeoff: Sterility could recreate the spreadsheet problem unless the museum has richer life and acting.

name: Sweeping Mythic Motion
visual_idea: Fluid traversal through broad readable spaces and monumental landmarks, with wide cameras that emphasize momentum.
tradeoff: Large open landscapes need adaptation to a room-based museum expedition.

name: Living Stone Geometry
visual_idea: Organic mineral forms and sculptural bodies make architecture feel alive rather than constructed.
tradeoff: Body-horror associations and heavy textures are unsuitable as the main child-facing style.

name: Hand-Animated Mechanical Mayhem
visual_idea: Exaggerated machinery, exceptionally expressive small animations and comic anticipation make every prop feel alive.
tradeoff: Borrow animation craft, not military imagery or the side-on corridor presentation.

name: Illustrated Impact
visual_idea: Large beautifully drawn combat silhouettes, bright environmental light and strong contact poses support readable close combat.
tradeoff: A fighting-lane camera could constrain the Tower's richer exploration.

name: Saturday-Morning Kinetics
reference: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge
visual_idea: Bright animated-show energy, clear team silhouettes and joyful exaggerated impacts turn danger into playful action.
tradeoff: Requires wholly original characters and a stronger mystery tone.

name: Pop-Panel Brawler
reference: Scott Pilgrim vs. The World: The Game
visual_idea: Graphic pixel crowds, playful impact effects and punchy color make short encounters immediately expressive.
tradeoff: Frequent numbers and effects could distract from the actual mathematical problem.

name: Anime Campus Brawl
visual_idea: Expressive character portraits, colorful urban spaces and lively readable combat create a confident youthful tone.
tradeoff: Portrait-led storytelling alone does not meet the movie requirement.

name: Rubber-Body Spectacle
visual_idea: Hand-drawn transformations and extreme squash-and-stretch give every attack a surprising visual idea.
tradeoff: Excessive transformation comedy could undermine a coherent protagonist and stakes.

name: Doodle Emergency
visual_idea: Bold marker lines and intentionally rough shapes support frantic movement in a visually immediate cartoon world.
tradeoff: Its aggressive chaos and crude humor are not a suitable full-game tone here.

name: Flat-Color Adventure Comedy
visual_idea: Simple silhouettes, brilliant color separation and readable group action create approachable arcade immediacy.
tradeoff: The visual simplicity needs richer lighting and film staging to avoid looking lightweight.

name: Elastic Color Velocity
visual_idea: Loops, strong directional composition and rhythmic color bands make movement itself visually exciting.
tradeoff: Constant high speed could prevent exploration and cannot be used while typing mathematics.

name: Sculpted Cel Precision
visual_idea: Clean 3D models rendered with graphic clarity, readable hazards and strong anticipation poses.
tradeoff: Its platform-grid structure must be replaced by more varied room geometry.

name: Synesthetic Geometry
visual_idea: Wireframe architecture pulses into solid form, linking sound, geometry and movement into one sensory language.
tradeoff: Too abstract for much of the character-driven museum story.

name: Metallic Tunnel Pulse
visual_idea: Monumental curves, hard metallic surfaces and rhythmic forward motion create overwhelming kinetic presence.
tradeoff: Better as a brief interlude influence; relentless pressure conflicts with thoughtful exploration.

name: Neon Vector Arena
visual_idea: Pristine geometric silhouettes, brilliant particles and exceptionally clear contrast turn shapes into dramatic actors.
tradeoff: Without richer characters and sets it would feel like an abstract exercise.

name: Vector Vortex
visual_idea: Graphic tunnels, radiating lines and a tightly controlled perspective give the screen a unique arcade identity.
tradeoff: An excellent special effect vocabulary, but too narrow for an entire adventure.

name: Luminous Circuit Museum
visual_idea: Black glass, embedded light lines and sculpted digital architecture make the museum feel computational.
tradeoff: A familiar neon-grid look needs substantial reinvention to feel owned by Math Tower.

name: Pop Dream Velocity
visual_idea: Bold color transitions, dreamlike scale shifts and musical camera choreography transform movement into spectacle.
tradeoff: Narrative clarity and player control must survive the frequent visual transformations.

name: Graphic Duel Theater
visual_idea: Small intense arenas, bold color contrast and theatrical character silhouettes make one-on-one conflict visually strong.
tradeoff: Useful for future duels, but a sequence of arenas alone would flatten exploration.

name: Bright Angular Pursuit
visual_idea: White geometric architecture, hard color accents and crisp forward routes emphasize speed and vertical movement.
tradeoff: Its speedrunning grammar would need optional pacing and a different narrative tone.

name: Alien Lightstorm
visual_idea: Volumetric light, bioluminescent particles and enormous threatening spaces give the impossible a powerful physical presence.
tradeoff: Its oppressive science-fiction horror and heavy rendering load are poor defaults here.

name: Cel-Shaded Momentum
visual_idea: Clean graphic shading and acrobatic curves make spatial movement legible even during spectacular action.
tradeoff: Borrow motion and framing, not armed arena sport as the core premise.

name: The Golden Impossible
visual_idea: Art Deco and early-modern spectacle reimagined as a mathematical institution: brass, malachite, lacquer and impossible moving exhibits.
tradeoff: The architecture must support a warm original adventure rather than import the reference's ideology or violence.

name: Oil-Painted Machinery
visual_idea: Stylized painterly surfaces, inventive clockwork rooms and believable signs of human use create a rich institution.
tradeoff: Dense realism and menace would need significant simplification and age adaptation.

name: Geometric Institution
visual_idea: Massive architectural forms and sudden surreal intrusions make an ordinary institution feel impossible.
tradeoff: An austere office aesthetic could recreate the clinical tone the user rejected.

name: Mythic Graphic Acrobatics
reference: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown
visual_idea: Clean stylized forms, excellent anticipation poses and monumental architectural silhouettes support fluid acrobatics.
tradeoff: The combat vocabulary should be adapted to non-graphic museum hazards and original lore.

name: Enchanted Kinetic Workshop
visual_idea: Painterly 3D sets, rich local light and playful physical machinery create theatrical depth around clear actions.
tradeoff: Too much ornament risks hiding platform and puzzle boundaries.

name: Industrial Puppet Drama
visual_idea: Expressive nonhuman characters and enormous working machines make the environment itself an antagonist.
tradeoff: The grim industrial oppression should remain a selective factory influence, not the opening tone.

name: Whimsical Isometric University
visual_idea: Rounded original characters and gently eccentric spatial design create an inviting, distinctive adventure world.
tradeoff: Soft presentation needs sharper action punctuation and cinematic urgency.

name: Overgrown Science Fiction
visual_idea: Warm color, vegetation over machinery and expressive cinematic partnership create beauty within danger.
tradeoff: An overgrown campus is a later possibility, not the original first-night setting.

name: Ink-Washed Palace
visual_idea: Outlined figures and soft painted architectural vistas turn impossible traversal into an illustrated adventure.
tradeoff: The distant vista must not make the hero small or the moment-to-moment game vague.

name: Living Brush Geometry
visual_idea: Brush strokes, ink effects and painted surfaces visibly reshape the world; mathematical marks become physical actions.
tradeoff: Borrow material transformation without reducing a specific cultural art tradition to decoration.

name: Minimalist Film Adventure
visual_idea: Strong silhouettes and uncompromising camera composition tell the story through movement and visual reveals.
tradeoff: Minimalism needs fuller acting and sound to avoid emotional distance.

name: Rotoscoped Academy Thriller
visual_idea: Grounded body motion, clean silhouettes and carefully staged transitions give the explorer physical credibility.
tradeoff: Its small side-view framing is unsuitable; only the motion and film grammar transfer.

name: Animated Peril Serial
visual_idea: Expressive child adventure, surprising creatures and dramatic camera transitions make danger feel like an animated movie.
tradeoff: Frequent peril needs a reassuring tone and forgiving recovery for this audience.

name: Pre-Rendered Oddity
visual_idea: Elaborate staged rooms, expressive creature acting and environmental machines create a distinctive cinematic world.
tradeoff: Fixed backgrounds can constrain improvisational play and room revisits.

name: Silhouette Suspense
visual_idea: Black-and-white staging and environmental scale create immediate suspense with almost no visual clutter.
tradeoff: Too bleak as the main identity; useful for one short, carefully controlled reveal.

name: Painted Companion Cinema
visual_idea: Beautiful broad compositions and character partnership move naturally between quiet film moments and playable puzzles.
tradeoff: Needs more varied arcade action and stronger mathematical machinery.

name: Theatrical Pulp Expedition
visual_idea: Richly painted absurd adventure spaces and expressive staging support a humorous scientific serial.
tradeoff: Narration should not replace visible character drama or interrupt every action.

name: Quiet Disaster Film
visual_idea: Wide cinematic silhouettes, environmental storytelling and naturalistic movement convey a catastrophe through human experience.
tradeoff: Too much ambiguity or slow traversal would conflict with the requested arcade excitement.

name: Ligne-Claire Dream Campus
visual_idea: Elegant drawn outlines over open 3D forms, restrained color and enormous skies create a completely distinctive world.
tradeoff: Flat shading requires stronger contrast and animation for small indoor threats.

name: Surreal Flow Cinema
visual_idea: Sweeping acrobatic movement across immense impossible forms, bold color and fluid camera arcs make geometry thrilling.
tradeoff: Strong camera motion needs accessibility options and a separate calm mode for mathematics.
